scope: Records the missing SSOT rule that composes the opl-instance-medopl deployment unit from capability migration. Documentation and specification only: no service was deployed, no Instance manifest was changed, no provider or money mutation ran.

problem.statement: No canonical owner stated that a target service may only enter the Instance unit after its capability and real callers have moved. Without that rule, 'deploy the whole target service set first' reads as a legitimate sequencing shortcut.
problem.observedConsequence: Deploying the target services ahead of their callers produces processes that can never become ready: every target owner resolves CloudIdentity from OPL_CLOUD_IDENTITY_URL and fails readiness when it is absent, and the only CloudIdentityAuthorization registrar is services/gateway-integration, which is not in the Instance unit.

sourceEvidence.fact: CloudIdentityAuthorization has exactly one non-test registrar, and it is the target gateway-integration service
Every target owner resolves the CloudIdentity address from OPL_CLOUD_IDENTITY_URL
With a database but no CloudIdentity address the owner installs a failing cloud_identity readiness check instead of claiming health
The Instance renderer and deploy set enumerate exactly three deployments today
The deployment target planner has one receipt path per enumerated deployment
Instance documentation states the --deploy-only set is exactly the three current deployments
The target architecture already fixes the ceiling at nine domain deployment units plus one Console BFF

implementation.architecture: docs/architecture.md gains 'Deployment Unit Composition': a service enters the unit in the same change that moves its capability off Control Plane; gateway-integration precedes the rest because every target owner authorizes through its gRPC boundary; the Console BFF replaces the Control Plane browser surface only after the capability it serves has moved.
implementation.roadmap: docs/roadmap.md maps each deployment batch to the work packages it carries (W02/W03/W13, W07/W08/W09, W06/W15, W10/W17, W14/W16/W22/W23/W26) and records that running the full target service set before its callers have moved is not a stage of the chain and carries no acceptance.
implementation.ownership: Cloud owns which capability each service owns; opl-instance-medopl owns the concrete unit. No new decisions entry, framework, service or workflow was added.

focusedVerification.coverage: no whitespace or conflict-marker defects in the documentation change

focusedVerification.command: rg -n 'Deployment Unit Composition' docs/ && rg -n 'deployment-unit-composition' docs/
focusedVerification.coverage: the architecture owner defines the section and the roadmap projection links to that exact anchor instead of restating the rule

notProven: That any target service is deployed on Tencent/TKE.
That gateway-integration runs in the Instance unit or is ready there.
That CloudIdentity authorization serves any target owner in production.
Any Instance receipt: this change produces no deployment, rollback or provider qualification evidence.
boundary: This receipt binds a documentation rule only. The Instance unit stays at its current three deployments until the owner of opl-instance-medopl adopts a batch, and Cloud does not dispatch that deployment.
